gate9_disposition.reason: content-dominated: of the 40 top-weighted features, ~32 are content words (garment/colour/lighting/scene nouns); the function words present ('the','on','under','is','at','of','with') are the gate-8 fingerprint already characterised in rounds 1-2. No new style axis.

v3_mechanism_verdict: FALSIFIED. v3's sole change was to relax A4's 'simple-present or present-progressive verbs' clause to permit plain is/are, A-role only, to close a claimed 8.8%-vs-0.5% be-verb tell. The A-role prompt was verified changed, yet the realised A-role be-verb rate stayed at 0.0% (round 2: 0.0%). The intended mechanism produced no measurable effect. Two further findings: (a) the 8.8% corpus figure is POOLED and mis-attributed — corpus A-role is only 5.0% (n=139) while corpus B-role is 25.0% (n=32, so 8 descriptions), i.e. the be-verb deficit is predominantly a B-role phenomenon and v3 deliberately did not touch the B prompt; (b) gate 8a moved 0.7066 -> 0.6929, a delta of 0.0137 against a fit std of 0.0568 — indistinguishable from run-to-run noise, so the improvement cannot be attributed to v3.
